description: Nursing Edge MongoDB collections included in mongodump backups. Matches learner-collections, relationship-collections, and admin audit surfaces in the learner API.

retention_expectation.development: Keep up to 14 timestamped dump folders under backups/ on developer storage; delete older dumps that contain learner PII.
retention_expectation.production: Keep at least 30 days of off-cluster dumps (encrypted object storage or ops vault) in addition to Atlas continuous backup if enabled. Rotate dump encryption keys per hosting policy.
retention_expectation.never_commit: Do not commit BSON/JSON dumps or backup-run reports that contain real learner data to git.

learner_identity_and_access.description: Learners, login codes, entitlements, access grant audit

learner_evidence.description: Sessions, attempts, exposures, Review cycles, interview deliveries, calibration

relationships.description: Maps, links, registries, teaching and evidence bindings, runtime roles

content_audit.description: Publish, pause, delete, and export audits from admin actions
